description.content: Performs search to retrieve list of places by input text and location vicinity.

query.description: (Required) The input to be searched.
Latitude of the location. We need to make sure that either Lat/Lng or Country is provided to API
Longitude of the location. We need to make sure that either Lat/Lng or Country is provided to API
Radius range within which search is performed.
Radius unit such as Feet, Kilometers, Miles or Meters.
Maximum number of POIs that can be retrieved.
Country ISO code. We need to make sure that either Lat/Lng or Country is provided to API
Option so that we force api to match on address number
Option to allow API to detect origin of API request automatically
State province of the input to be searched
City of the input to be searched
Postal Code of the input to be searched
if value set 'Y' then it will only do a matching on postcode or areaName1, areaName2, areaName3 and areaName4 fields in the data
if value set 'Y' then display all unit info of ranges, if value set 'N' then don't show ranges
Preference to control search type of interactive requests.
Preference to search on address number.
Preference to search on unit info.
Specifies whether to enable search for matching on PO Box.

Demographics. Audience Enrichment. Add local demographics and lifestyle
segmentation to your audience profiles. The Demographics API returns
household demographics and lifestyle characteristics with the input of an
address, location coordinate, or geographic boundary. This service covers
select countries.
